coefficient_firewall: Support certificates are Q-linear; negative and denominator-bearing classes remain valid rational classes and are not retyped as effective cycles.
definition: SUPPORT_2(alpha;Z) iff j^* alpha=0 in H^4(X_F-Z,Q), equivalently alpha is in im[H_Z^4(X_F,Q)->H^4(X_F,Q)].
support_enlargement_monotonicity: If Z subset Z' and SUPPORT_2(alpha;Z), functoriality H_Z^4 -> H_Z'^4 transports the certificate, so SUPPORT_2(alpha;Z').
support_top_carrier: For a union Z of m irreducible complex surfaces in smooth X_F, H_Z^4(X_F,Q) identifies at top degree with H_4^BM(Z,Q), with one Q fundamental generator per irreducible surface component.
